tools.name: validate_iban
tools.title: Validate IBAN
tools.description: Validate an IBAN offline against the bundled SWIFT IBAN Registry snapshot: country, length, BBAN structure and MOD-97 check digits. Does not confirm the account exists.

tools.name: build_iban
tools.title: Build IBAN
tools.description: Build an IBAN from its BBAN fields and compute the MOD-97 check digits. Call without `fields` first to get the country's field template.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE.

fields.description: Map of template field id to value, e.g. { bank: '37040044', account: '0532013000' }.

tools.name: check_bic
tools.title: Check BIC syntax
tools.description: ISO 9362 BIC syntax and ISO 3166 country-code checks. No bank directory is bundled, so it cannot confirm a BIC exists or is reachable; never use it for routing or compliance decisions.

tools.name: explain_payment_message
tools.title: Explain payment message
tools.description: Explain an ISO 20022 payment message. pacs.008, pacs.009 and camt.053 get a plain-language narrative; pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.052 and camt.054 get a structured field projection. All get an operator summary and quick insights.

path.description: Path to a local XML file. Prefer this for real data so it never enters the chat.

tools.name: scrub_payment_message
tools.title: Scrub payment message
tools.description: Replace names, IBANs, account ids, UETRs and references in a pacs/camt message with consistent pseudonyms. With `path` + `output_path`, writes the scrubbed copy to disk and returns only masked statistics, so the original data never enters the conversation. Never overwrites an existing file.

path.description: Path to a local XML file. Prefer this for real data so it never enters the chat.

output_path.description: Where to write the scrubbed XML. Must not exist yet and must differ from `path`.

tools.name: check_cbpr_readiness
tools.title: Check CBPR+ readiness
tools.description: Local CBPR+ readiness hints: AppHdr/Document namespaces, schema-profile coverage, UETR, BIC and IBAN syntax. Readiness hints, not MyStandards usage-rule validation.

path.description: Path to a local XML file. Prefer this for real data so it never enters the chat.

tools.name: analyze_payment_lifecycle
tools.title: Analyze payment lifecycle
tools.description: Group a set of ACK/NACK, pacs and camt files by shared identifiers (UETR, EndToEndId, TxId) into threads with a timeline and warnings. Works only on the files given.

tools.name: validate_ssi_file
tools.title: Validate SSI file
tools.description: Validate a standing settlement instruction (SSI) file: a SWIFTRef SSI Plus V3 extract or a CSV/TSV export. Checks BIC, ISO country, ISO 4217 currency and SSI asset-category formats, required fields, preferred flags, lifecycle dates, staleness, and conflicts (two preferred correspondents, overlapping active instructions). Rule ids match SSI Control Tower. Accounts are masked in the output.

ssi_path.description: Path to the local SSI file. Prefer this: the file never enters the chat.

ssi_content.description: The SSI file content, inline (small files only).

as_of.description: Date to judge active and stale instructions, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

tools.name: check_payment_against_ssi
tools.title: Check payment against SSI file
tools.description: Check that a payment pays the beneficiary institution through the correspondent and account in the user's own SSI file. Reads the route from a pacs.008 (creditor agent, last intermediary, CdtrAgtAcct) or pacs.009 (creditor, creditor agent, CdtrAcct), or from explicit fields, then looks up owner BIC + currency + asset category and compares with the preferred SSI effective on the value date. Returns MATCH, ACCOUNT_MISMATCH, AGENT_MISMATCH, NOT_PREFERRED, AMBIGUOUS_SSI, NO_EFFECTIVE_SSI or NO_SSI per transaction. Accounts are masked.

ssi_path.description: Path to the user's SSI file (SWIFTRef SSI Plus V3, CSV or TSV).

ssi_content.description: The SSI file content, inline (small files only).

path.description: Path to a local XML file. Prefer this for real data so it never enters the chat.

owner_bic.description: Beneficiary institution BIC (the SSI owner). Overrides the message.

asset_category.description: SSI asset category such as COPA, CASH, FOEX, SECU. Overrides the default for the message type.

account_holder_bic.description: Correspondent (account-holding institution) BIC used by the payment. Overrides the message.

account.description: Account at the correspondent used by the payment. Overrides the message.

value_date.description: Value date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the message settlement date, else today.

tools.name: decode_reason_code
tools.title: Decode status or reason code
tools.description: Explain an ISO 20022 status or reason code such as RJCT, AC01 or MD07. Omit `code` to list the curated set.
